headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a decisive 10-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jake Mangum leading the Braves' offense. In other action, the New York Mets took down the Kansas City Royals 7-3, while the Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 12-4. The Chicago Cubs fell short in Baltimore, dropping a 2-3 decision to the Orioles.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Tanner Banks, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Philadelphia Phillies due to a left forearm strain. Other players on the injured list include Brad Lord (Washington Nationals), Owen Caissie (Miami Marlins), John King (Miami Marlins), Tim Herrin (Cleveland Guardians), Ranger Suarez (Boston Red Sox), Connor Prielipp (Minnesota Twins), and Samad Taylor (San Diego Padres).

The New York Mets made a trade with the Detroit Tigers, acquiring right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in exchange for cash. The Minnesota Twins also made a trade with the Detroit Tigers, acquiring right-handed pitcher Woo-Suk Go for cash. Additionally, the Cleveland Guardians acquired right-handed pitcher Ryan Degges from the Philadelphia Phillies in a trade for cash, while the Washington Nationals acquired left-handed pitcher Tom Cosgrove from the Houston Astros in a trade for cash.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Past Pirates 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a decisive victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with a strong team performance. Jake Mangum led the Braves' offense with a 4-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Royals in 7-3 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 7.0 innings of work. Tyrone Taylor led the Royals' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Juan Soto's 21st homer of the season proved pivotal for the Mets.

top_news.title: **Yankees Blast Past Rays 12-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-4 victory. Ben Rice led the Yankees' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dropped a 2-3 decision to the Baltimore Orioles, unable to overcome a strong Orioles performance. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Trevor Rogers pitched 6 strong innings for the Cubs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Place Tanner Banks on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tanner Banks, a left-handed pitcher for the Philadelphia Phillies, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left forearm strain. This move was made on July 9, 2026.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
